description: This file is a shell script containing a series of tests related to Git worktrees and refs, primarily focused on verifying per-worktree refs, resolve mechanisms, reflog behavior, and for-each-ref listing in a Git repository environment.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified directory or repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: Compares two revisions/refs to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes for cleanup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares contents of files or output streams.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
